call_points.text: AUM reached ₹74,008 crore, reflecting 10.4% QoQ growth.
NIM for the quarter stood at 9.26%, up 16 bps QoQ.
Capital adequacy ratio is robust at 18.68% with Tier 1 at 17.15%.
Disbursement yield rose 40 bps to about 15.96% from 15.56%, which management says will pull portfolio yield up gradually.
ROA reached 1.81% in Q4FY26 versus 1.2% last quarter and 0.78% in Q4FY25; management calls it the new baseline.
Asked for fee-income guidance, management said it is a strong focus but gave no number.
Management guides to continue growing AUM at ~35-40% CAGR over the next couple of years.
Long-term vision aspires for 5-6x AUM expansion over the next 5 years.
Simulated Capital Adequacy Ratio stands at 20.74% post-QIP basis March 2026 balance sheet.

operating_notes.text: AUM was ₹55,017 crore as on December 31, 2025, with 5,264 employees as of the same date.
AI programme spans 57 initiatives across risk, credit, compliance, HR, operations and business functions, with 41 deployed.
Finance Committee approved up to ₹250 Cr of unsecured Tier II NCDs (base ₹150 Cr, green shoe ₹100 Cr), series SDA1 FY2026-27, to be listed on BSE.
Total borrowings stood at ₹48,098 Cr as of March 31, 2026, with NCD share rising to 32% from 7% in March 2025.
Cost of borrowing reduced to 7.63% in Q4FY26 from 8.07% in Q4FY25.
Finance Committee approved issuing secured, redeemable, rated, listed NCDs aggregating up to ₹1,000 Cr under Series B1 FY2026-27.
Q4FY26 disbursement yield rose 40 bps to about 15.96% from 15.56% a quarter earlier, with portfolio yield expected to catch up gradually.
PL Prime monthly disbursement run rate was about ₹468 Cr at March 2026, with 33% of Q4 disbursements through fully straight-through digital processing versus 28% in Q3.
Commercial vehicle disbursements averaged about ₹125 Cr a month in Q4, up 18% QoQ, and FY26 disbursements were ₹1,000 Cr with used CV over 70%.
Fixed June 11, 2026 as record date for mandatory redemption of ₹8 Cr partly paid NCDs (ISIN INE511C07904) due on June 26, 2026.
Prime personal loan monthly disbursements ₹537 Cr; 38% processed fully digitally.
Education loan average monthly disbursement ₹144 Cr, up 55% QoQ.
Gold loan network expanded to 550 branches.

timeline.summary: On 20 April 2026 Poonawalla Fincorp announced a next-generation conversational AI customer-service platform, saying its AI programme spans 57 initiatives with 41 deployed.
On 21 April 2026 Poonawalla Fincorp's Finance Committee approved issuing up to ₹250 Cr of unsecured Tier II NCDs (base ₹150 Cr plus ₹100 Cr green shoe) by private placement, to be listed on BSE.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,115.49 Cr (+81.4% YoY), net profit ₹254.79 Cr (+308.8% YoY).
Poonawalla Fincorp released Q4FY26 presentation guiding for ~35-40% AUM CAGR following ₹2,500 Cr QIP capital raise.
Poonawalla Fincorp Limited shared Q4FY2025-26 earnings conference call recording on May 5, 2026, via its website.
Poonawalla Fincorp's Finance Committee approved issuing secured NCDs aggregating up to ₹1,000 Cr via private placement.
Poonawalla Fincorp received an exchange clarification request regarding XBRL discrepancies in its Q4FY26 financial results on May 8, 2026.

Poonawalla Fincorp released the transcript of its May 5, 2026 Q4FY26 earnings call, where it held 35-40% AUM growth guidance, reported NIM of 9.05% and ROA of 1.81%, and said all 400 gold branches were operational.
Poonawalla Fincorp decided to exercise the call option on its ₹3 Cr 12.10% perpetual NCDs, with record date May 27, 2026 and redemption on June 12, 2026, subject to RBI approval.
Poonawalla Fincorp fixed June 11, 2026 as record date for the redemption of ₹8 Cr partly paid NCDs.
Poonawalla Fincorp announced the exercise of a call option to redeem ₹1.70 Cr perpetual NCDs on July 3, 2026, with record date June 18, 2026.
Q1FY27 earnings call: AUM ₹67,054 Cr (+11.1% QoQ), PAT ₹308 Cr (+20.8% QoQ), GNPA 1.37%, ROA 1.98%; management guides to 3-3.5% ROA by June 2028.
Poonawalla Fincorp reported Q2FY27 PAT of ₹375 Cr on an AUM of ₹74,008 Cr, driven by strong retail momentum and improved asset quality.
Finance Committee approved issuance of up to ₹2,000 Cr secured, listed NCDs across two series via private placement on BSE.
